description: Piped secret without a trailing newline: make `agro secret set` write a piped value that has no trailing newline.

userStories.title: Write a piped value that has no trailing newline
userStories.description: As the operator, I want `agro secret set <KEY>` to write a piped value without a trailing newline so that a script never hides an unwritten secret.
acceptanceCriteria: A test in `.agro/cli/src/lib/__tests__/` pipes `value` with no trailing newline into `askSecretPiped` through `askSecret` and asserts that the result is `value`.
A test asserts that empty piped input resolves to an empty string, so that `runSecretSet` exits 1 with `no value entered`.
The new tests fail before the change in `.agro/cli/src/lib/prompt.ts`.
`CHANGELOG.md` has one `### Fixed` entry under `## [Unreleased]` that links #1409.
userStories.notes: AC1-2 executed: prompt-piped.test.ts swaps process.stdin for a Readable; no-newline input returns value; empty input returns empty string (config-secret.test.ts covers the exit 1 for an empty value). AC3 executed by the worker: both new cases timed out before the fix. AC4 executed on the integrated branch: vitest on lib/__tests__ plus config-secret exit 0 (252 passed). AC5 executed: npm run typecheck exit 0. AC6 reasoned from the diff: one Fixed entry links #1409 and #1411. Root cause: rl.question settles only on a newline-terminated line.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a command transcript so that the PR shows the changed behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/piped-secret-newline/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the output and exit code of `printf '%s' dummy-not-a-secret | node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js secret set GH_TOKEN --sandbox review-box` in a temporary `AGRO_HOME`, and of `agro secret list --sandbox review-box` after the write.
The file holds the output and exit code of `printf '' | node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js secret set GH_TOKEN --sandbox review-box`, and that exit code is 1.
The transcript holds no secret value.
The story deletes each temporary directory that it creates.
userStories.notes: AC1-2 executed by the worker and copied from the observed run: no-newline pipe exit 0 then list shows GH_TOKEN set; empty pipe prints no value entered and exits 1, list shows no secrets set. AC3 executed by the advisor: only the dummy string appears. AC4 executed by the worker: both temp homes removed.
